draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.16, the 109th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 11th of 30 at LB. He lasted until pick 167, well after his grade rank (109th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Christian Kirksey. Testing concerns: 20-yard shuttle (14th percentile), vertical jump (15th percentile). College production: 94 tackles in 2022, 6th of 30 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 4 pro, currently with the Houston Texans (reserve). 46 career games and 35 starts over 3 completed seasons, plus 1 so far in 2026. Producing near his peak: 7 AV in 2025 against a career-best 7 in 2024. Strengths in 2025: tackles for loss 9 (95th percentile), sacks 2.5 (87th percentile), approximate value 7 (80th percentile). Weak spots: missed tackle rate 15.9% (5th percentile), passer rating allowed 107.8 (21st percentile). Versus the typical Year-3 off-ball linebacker who played: 95 combined tackles against a median of 40, above the norm.
